table.name: TLGNC_PLANT_SAREA
table.description: A plant can be assigned to several sales areas even if they are not assigned to the same company code as the sales organization. One sales area does the business with the customer. This sales area is assigned to a company code. The plant, from where the product is delivered belongs to another company code, but it is also assigned to the sales area that sells to the customer.

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. (Production) plant related to the Sales Areas. One Plant can be assigned to many Sales Areas.

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SAREA. Sales Area related to the plants. One Sales Area can be assigned to many Plants
